references.title: What Is Service Catalog?
references.quote: End users can quickly deploy only the approved IT services they need, following the constraints set by your organization.
references.supports: Service Catalog giới hạn developer chỉ triển khai sản phẩm (AMI) đã phê duyệt.

references.title: AWS Service Catalog Launch Constraints
references.quote: By using a launch role, you can instead limit the end users' permissions to the minimum they require for that product.
references.supports: Developer chỉ cần quyền Service Catalog, không cần quyền EC2 trực tiếp - ngăn launch AMI chưa duyệt.

references.title: Managing stacks across accounts and Regions with StackSets
references.quote: create, update, or delete stacks across multiple accounts and AWS Regions with a single operation.
references.supports: StackSets nhằm triển khai nhiều account - trái với phạm vi chỉ account dev (D).

references.title: CloudFormation template Mappings syntax
references.quote: One common use case for the Mappings section is to set values based on the AWS Region where the stack is deployed.
references.supports: Chọn AMI theo Region dùng Mappings, không phải Conditions (A mô tả cơ chế lệch).

references.title: CloudFormation template Conditions syntax
references.quote: The optional Conditions section contains statements that define the circumstances under which entities are created or configured.
references.supports: Conditions không phải cơ chế kiểm soát quyền launch; template không ngăn developer launch AMI khác (A).

references.title: AWS Service Catalog Launch Constraints
references.quote: Without a launch constraint, end users must launch and manage products using their own IAM credentials.
references.supports: C chặt chẽ khi developer chỉ có quyền Service Catalog và product dùng launch role; nếu không, họ cần quyền EC2 riêng và có thể bỏ qua portfolio.

references.title: AWS service events delivered via AWS CloudTrail
references.quote: Events that represent a request to a public AWS service API.
references.supports: Rule EventBridge cho RunInstances phản ứng với lệnh gọi API đã xảy ra - không ngăn việc launch AMI chưa duyệt (B).

references.title: Control the discovery and use of AMIs in Amazon EC2 with Allowed AMIs
references.quote: When the criteria are enabled, users launching instances will only see and have access to AMIs that comply with the specified criteria.
references.supports: Allowed AMIs là cơ chế mới hơn cũng giới hạn AMI, nhưng không có trong các lựa chọn; không làm thay đổi đáp án.
